stem: A pair of shoes costs ₱1,200. It is on sale at 25% off. What is the sale price?
hints: "25% off" means you pay 100% − 25% = 75% of the price.

solution.methodName: Discount: pay (100% − discount) of the price

steps.why: 25% is the same as 1/4, and 1/4 of a number is that number ÷ 4.

steps.action: Check another way: you pay 75% = 3/4 of ₱1,200, and 3 × ₱300 = ₱900. The sale price is ₱900.

trapNotes.₱300: This is the discount (25% of ₱1,200). Subtract it from the original price to get the sale price.
trapNotes.₱1,175: This takes off 25 pesos. 25% off means 25% of ₱1,200, which is ₱300.
trapNotes.₱1,500: This adds the discount. A discount lowers the price.
